successCriteria.description: The `LeaveBalance` entity is defined and exported from `balance.model.ts` with fields: `id`, `employeeId`, `policyId`, `totalEntitlement`, `usedDays`, `pendingDays`, `remainingDays` (derived getter returning `totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays`, not stored), `fiscalYear`, `status` (`'ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN' | 'CLOSED'`), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. Extends `BaseEntity`. Does NOT include a `carriedOver` field.

The `IBalanceRepository` interface is defined and exported from `balance.model.ts` declaring: `findByEmployeeAndYear(employeeId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<LeaveBalance[]>`, `findByEmployeeYearAndPolicy(employeeId: string, fiscalYear: number, policyId: string): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>`, `create(balance: Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeaveBalance>`, `update(id: string, data: Partial<LeaveBalance>): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>`, `deductPendingDays(id: string, days: number, client?: PoolClient): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>`, `commitDeduction(id: string, days: number, client?: PoolClient): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>`, `restorePendingDays(id: string, days: number, client?: PoolClient): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>`.

`BalanceRepository` implements `IBalanceRepository` using the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`. Table: `leave_balances`. All queries use parameterized SQL. A private `mapRow(row: DbRow): LeaveBalance` helper converts snake_case DB columns to camelCase. The `remainingDays` field is NOT read from the DB — it is computed in `mapRow` as `totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays`.

`deductPendingDays(id, days)` atomically increments `pendingDays` by `days` using `UPDATE leave_balances SET pending_days = pending_days + $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING *`. Returns the updated `LeaveBalance` or `null` if the row does not exist.

`commitDeduction(id, days)` atomically moves `days` from `pendingDays` to `usedDays` using `UPDATE leave_balances SET pending_days = pending_days - $1, used_days = used_days + $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING *`. Returns the updated `LeaveBalance` or `null` if the row does not exist.

`restorePendingDays(id, days)` atomically decrements `pendingDays` by `days` using `UPDATE leave_balances SET pending_days = pending_days - $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING *`. Returns the updated `LeaveBalance` or `null` if the row does not exist.

`deductPendingDays`, `commitDeduction`, and `restorePendingDays` each accept an optional `client: PoolClient` parameter. When provided, the method uses that client for the query instead of the shared pool, enabling the caller to orchestrate multi-step transactions.

`create(balance)` inserts a row into `leave_balances` with columns: `employee_id`, `policy_id`, `total_entitlement`, `used_days`, `pending_days`, `fiscal_year`, `status`. The `id` is generated via `randomUUID()`. `usedDays` and `pendingDays` default to `0` if not provided. Returns the created `LeaveBalance`.

constraints: The `remainingDays` field MUST be a derived getter (`get remainingDays(): number { return this.totalEntitlement - this.usedDays - this.pendingDays; }`) — it is NOT stored in the database and NOT read from any DB column. The `mapRow` helper computes it from the stored `total_entitlement`, `used_days`, and `pending_days` columns.

The `carried_over` column exists in the `leave_balances` table (per reconciled architecture) but MUST NOT be mapped to the `LeaveBalance` entity. The repository's `mapRow` must not read it, and no query may write to it.
All repository methods MUST use parameterized SQL (`$1`, `$2`, …) — never string interpolation or template concatenation for values.
The repository MUST import `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` using the path `shared/db/connection` (matching the existing pattern in employee, policy, audit, and notification repositories).

Domain errors defined in `balance.model.ts` MUST extend `Error`, set `this.name` to the error class name in the constructor, and follow the naming convention `XxxError` (e.g., `BalanceNotFoundError`).
The `DbRow` type alias (`type DbRow = Record<string, unknown>`) MUST be used for all query result rows, matching the pattern in every existing repository.

The `update` method MUST use a dynamic field-map pattern (array of `[column_name, entityKey]` tuples) to build the SET clause, matching the pattern in `EmployeeRepository.update` and `PolicyRepository.update`. It MUST set `updated_at = NOW()` on every update.
outOfScope: Unit tests (`tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.spec.ts` and any other test files) — these are produced by sibling sub-phase 5c.
`BalanceService`, `BalanceController`, `balance.routes.ts`, and the barrel `index.ts` — these are produced by sibling sub-phase 5b.
Database migration for the `leave_balances` table — assumed to exist per the reconciled architecture.

entityInvariants.invariant: `remainingDays` is always `totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays`. It is a derived getter, never stored. The entity's `status` is driven by `remainingDays`: when `remainingDays === 0`, status transitions to `EXHAUSTED`; when `remainingDays > 0` and status was `EXHAUSTED`, it returns to `ACTIVE`. Status `FROZEN` is set externally (admin action). Status `CLOSED` is terminal (year-end).

A `LeaveBalance` is uniquely identified by the combination `(employeeId, policyId, fiscalYear)`. No two balance records may exist for the same employee, policy, and fiscal year. The repository's `create` method should rely on the database unique constraint on `(employee_id, policy_id, fiscal_year)` to enforce this.

`usedDays` and `pendingDays` must never be negative. The atomic SQL operations (`deductPendingDays`, `commitDeduction`, `restorePendingDays`) must guard against negative values — the UPDATE should include a WHERE clause (e.g., `WHERE pending_days >= $1`) to prevent the operation if it would produce a negative result, returning `null` in that case.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an empty array (never null) when no balances exist for the given employee and fiscal year.
Returns `null` when no balance exists for the given employee, fiscal year, and policy combination. Does not throw.

Returns the updated `LeaveBalance` on success. Returns `null` if the balance row does not exist OR if the operation would cause `pendingDays` to become negative (guarded by `WHERE pending_days >= $days` in the UPDATE). Does not throw.

Returns the created `LeaveBalance`. The repository generates `id` via `randomUUID()` and sets `createdAt`/`updatedAt` via database defaults (`NOW()`).
Returns the updated `LeaveBalance` on success. Returns `null` if no row with the given `id` exists. Does not throw.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `DbRow` type alias (`type DbRow = Record<string, unknown>`) and the private `mapRow(row: DbRow): LeaveBalance` helper pattern MUST match the existing repositories: `EmployeeRepository.mapRow` (src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts), `PolicyRepository.mapRow` (src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts), and `AuditRepository.mapRow` (src/modules/audit/audit.repository.ts).

The `update` method's dynamic field-map pattern MUST match `EmployeeRepository.update` (src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts) and `PolicyRepository.update` (src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts): an array of `[column_name, entityKey]` tuples, building SET clauses with positional parameters, appending `updated_at = NOW()`, and returning the updated row via `RETURNING *`.

Domain error classes MUST follow the pattern in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` and `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts`: extend `Error`, set `this.name` to the class name in the constructor, accept a descriptive identifier parameter, and produce a human-readable message.

The `LeaveBalance` entity MUST extend `BaseEntity` from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts`, matching how `Employee` extends `BaseEntity` in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` and `LeavePolicy` extends `BaseEntity` in `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts`.

The `pool` import path MUST be `shared/db/connection` (not a relative path), matching every existing repository: `EmployeeRepository` (src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts), `PolicyRepository` (src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts), `AuditRepository` (src/modules/audit/audit.repository.ts).

integrationPoints.why: Imports `BaseEntity` for the `LeaveBalance` entity to extend. No other shared type imports needed.
